1: // Simple space asteroid escape game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: // Ship at bottom moves left/right (A/D or Arrow keys) and shoots upward (Space).
3: // Asteroids fall with random size, speed, rotation. Collision ends the game.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9:   const width = canvas.width;
10:   const height = canvas.height;
11: 
12:   // ----- Game objects -----
13:   const ship = {
14:     width: 40,
15:     height: 20,
16:     x: width / 2 - 20,
17:     y: height - 30,
18:     speed: 5,
19:     color: '#0f0',
20:   };
21: 
22:   const bullets = [];
23:   const asteroids = [];
24:   let gameOver = false;
25:   let lastAsteroidTime = 0;
26:   const asteroidInterval = 800; // ms
27: 
28:   // ----- Input handling -----
29:   const keys = {};
30:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
31:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
32: 
33:   function spawnAsteroid() {
34:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20; // 20-50px
35:     const speed = Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5; // 0.5-2.0 px/frame
36:     const rotation = Math.random() * 0.1 - 0.05; // -0.05..0.05 rad/frame
37:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
38:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed, angle: 0, rotation });
39:   }
40: 
41:   function shoot() {
42:     bullets.push({ x: ship.x + ship.width / 2, y: ship.y, speed: 7 });
43:   }
44: 
45:   function update(dt) {
46:     // ship movement
47:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
48:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.x += ship.speed;
49:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.width, ship.x));
50: 
51:     // shooting (space)
52:     if (keys[' '] && !keys['_spaceLocked']) {
53:       shoot();
54:       keys['_spaceLocked'] = true; // simple debounce
55:     }
56:     if (!keys[' ']) keys['_spaceLocked'] = false;
57: 
58:     // update bullets
59:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
60:       const b = bullets[i];
61:       b.y -= b.speed;
62:       if (b.y < 0) bullets.splice(i, 1);
63:     }
64: 
65:     // spawn asteroids
66:     if (Date.now() - lastAsteroidTime > asteroidInterval) {
67:       spawnAsteroid();
68:       lastAsteroidTime = Date.now();
69:     }
70: 
71:     // update asteroids
72:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
73:       const a = asteroids[i];
74:       a.y += a.speed;
75:       a.angle += a.rotation;
76:       // check collision with ship (circle-rect approx)
77:       const distX = Math.max(ship.x, Math.min(a.x + a.size / 2, ship.x + ship.width));
78:       const distY = Math.max(ship.y, Math.min(a.y + a.size / 2, ship.y + ship.height));
79:       const dx = a.x + a.size / 2 - distX;
80:       const dy = a.y + a.size / 2 - distY;
81:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (a.size / 2) * (a.size / 2)) {
82:         gameOver = true;
83:       }
84:       // bullet collision
85:       for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
86:         const b = bullets[j];
87:         const bx = b.x;
88:         const by = b.y;
89:         const ax = a.x + a.size / 2;
90:         const ay = a.y + a.size / 2;
91:         const dist = Math.hypot(bx - ax, by - ay);
92:         if (dist < a.size / 2) {
93:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
94:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
95:           break;
96:         }
97:       }
98:       // remove if off screen
99:       if (a.y - a.size > height) {
100:         // asteroid reached bottom -> lose condition
101:         gameOver = true;
102:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
103:       }
104:     }
105:   }
106: 
107:   function draw() {
108:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
109:     // ship
110:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
111:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.width, ship.height);
112:     // bullets
113:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
114:     bullets.forEach(b => ctx.fillRect(b.x - 2, b.y - 6, 4, 6));
115:     // asteroids
116:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
117:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
118:       ctx.save();
119:       ctx.translate(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2);
120:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
121:       ctx.fillRect(-a.size / 2, -a.size / 2, a.size, a.size);
122:       ctx.restore();
123:     });
124:     if (gameOver) {
125:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
126:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
127:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
128:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
129:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
130:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
131:     }
132:   }
133: 
134:   let lastTime = 0;
135:   function loop(timestamp) {
136:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
137:     lastTime = timestamp;
138:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
139:     draw();
140:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
141:   }
142:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
143: })();

(End of file - total 143 lines)
</content>
